review: The curve is a zigzag, not a ramp. First Steps lets my mid-skill run stand in front of a spike pair for 45 seconds, which is a bad first lesson. Saw Mill kills at 2 seconds with two moving saws before it teaches one, and only 27% pass at stage 3. Spring Loaded then has zero deaths, so the springs carry no risk. Crumble Bridge and Laser Gate are the best: one mechanic, clear telegraph, readable deaths. Gauntlet mixes all mechanics well, but the laser at 67% stacks most deaths in one spot and reads as a timing trap.
best: Laser Gate teaches the blinking beams on flat ground first and then adds spikes and a saw, with deaths spread out and readable.
worst: Saw Mill is a stage 3 difficulty wall that kills a mid-skill player with a saw in the first two seconds.
